findings.highlight: who was understood by no one
findings.evidenceJa: 最期まで誰にも理解されなかった
findings.governingReading: whom no one understood until his final moment
findings.explanation: The duration of the knight’s lifelong isolation disappears.

findings.highlight: he died
findings.evidenceJa: あっけなく死んだだけ
findings.governingReading: he simply died an abrupt, anticlimactic death
findings.explanation: Rin’s dismissive account of the ease and bathos of his death is flattened to the event.

findings.highlight: Compassion does no good for others
findings.evidenceJa: 情けは人の為ならず
findings.governingReading: Kindness is not merely for the recipient; it returns to the giver
findings.explanation: mirror moon states the proverb’s familiar false interpretation, directly opposing Rin’s following explanation that actions cycle back and replenish the actor.

findings.highlight: he managed a miracle with his own blood
findings.evidenceJa: 血を流しながら成し得た奇蹟
findings.governingReading: the miracle he accomplished while shedding blood
findings.explanation: Suffering and sacrifice during his effort become blood as the means or fuel of the miracle.

findings.highlight: a scene of some natural disaster
findings.evidenceJa: 何かの事故現場
findings.governingReading: the site of some kind of accident
findings.explanation: The English invents natural causation; the source only distinguishes an accident or calamity from devastation caused by conflict.

findings.highlight: nor would he be promoted to a “heroic spirit”
findings.evidenceJa: “英霊”として登録される事もない
findings.governingReading: nor would he be registered as a Heroic Spirit
findings.explanation: Entry into the world’s heroic-spirit record is turned into advancement through a rank hierarchy.

findings.highlight: Being a “servant”.
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=サーヴァント char=2]奴隷
findings.governingReading: A slave, read as “Servant”
findings.explanation: The explicit written judgment that the posthumous Servant role is slavery disappears.

findings.highlight: Superior spirits chosen from amongst humans
findings.evidenceJa: 人間から輩出された優れた霊格
findings.governingReading: superior spiritual ranks produced from humanity
findings.explanation: The English invents an act of selection and obscures emergence from human beings.

findings.highlight: give up his body after his death
findings.evidenceJa: 死後の自分を差し出して
findings.governingReading: offer up his posthumous self
findings.explanation: The contract’s claim over his continuing self after death is narrowed to a corpse or body.

findings.highlight: Desire
findings.evidenceJa: 妄念
findings.governingReading: delusive obsession
findings.explanation: A dark, distorted fixation is reduced to ordinary desire in the list of human ugliness.

findings.highlight: the same ugliness
findings.evidenceJa: 同じ[ruby text=もの o2o=1]醜さ
findings.governingReading: the same ugliness, read more neutrally as “thing”
findings.explanation: The written condemnation and spoken distancing layer are flattened into a single judgment.

findings.highlight: I knew it
findings.evidenceJa: 薄々そうだろうとは思ってた
findings.governingReading: I had half suspected as much
findings.explanation: Rin’s tentative prior suspicion is promoted to knowledge.

findings.highlight: get a glimpse of his memory
findings.evidenceJa: あっちの記憶層に迷い込む
findings.governingReading: wander into his memory layer
findings.explanation: The involuntary spatial mechanism of entering Archer’s layered memory becomes ordinary viewing.

findings.highlight: my eyelids are heavier than steel
findings.evidenceJa: 目蓋も石か鉄みたいに重い
findings.governingReading: my eyelids feel as heavy as stone or steel
findings.explanation: A comparison to the weight of stone or iron/steel becomes the physically absurd claim that her eyelids outweigh steel.

findings.highlight: I don’t know if this is as I expected or not
findings.evidenceJa: 納得したというか、意外だったというか
findings.governingReading: I do not know whether to call it clarifying or surprising
findings.explanation: Rin’s mixed sense of new understanding and surprise becomes a question of prior prediction.

findings.highlight: Are you telling me to stoop so low?
findings.evidenceJa: あんな外道と志を同じにしろっていうの
findings.governingReading: Are you telling me to share an aim with such an inhuman brute?
findings.explanation: Rin’s outrage at aligning her principles with Kuzuki’s becomes generic loss of status or dignity.

findings.highlight: Caster is a heretic
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターは外道だ
findings.governingReading: Caster is an inhuman villain
findings.explanation: A moral condemnation becomes a religious or doctrinal category, importing the wrong sense of 外道.

findings.highlight: I’m not as loose as Emiya Shirou
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎ほど甘くはない
findings.governingReading: I am not as naive or soft as Emiya Shirou
findings.explanation: Rin’s judgment of Shirou’s leniency and idealism becomes a potentially sexual or morally lax description.

findings.highlight: I won’t give them up no matter who’s telling me so
findings.evidenceJa: 相手が何者であろうと、それを譲る気なんかない
findings.governingReading: Whatever my opponent may be, I have no intention of yielding them
findings.explanation: Rin’s resolve against any kind of opposing party becomes resistance to whoever verbally advises her.

findings.highlight: I shall look after you
findings.evidenceJa: 陰ながら見守るとしよう
findings.governingReading: I shall watch over you from the shadows
findings.explanation: Archer’s characteristic distancing qualification disappears, making his care more direct.
